motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to The Municipal Act, to consider: Ontario Energy Board Generic Proceeding to Review Natural Gas Model Franchise Agreement - 2026-331 As per section 239(2) (f) of the Municipal Act regarding advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose. Downtown Community Planning Permitting By-law and Official Plan Amendment 114 - Ontario Land Tribunal - 2026-360 As per section 239(2) (e) and (f) of the Municipal Act regarding litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board, and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.
motions.text_html:
That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to The Municipal Act, to consider:

Ontario Energy Board Generic Proceeding to Review Natural Gas Model Franchise Agreement - 2026-331 
As per section 239(2) (f) of the Municipal Act regarding advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.

Downtown Community Planning Permitting By-law and Official Plan Amendment 114 - Ontario Land Tribunal - 2026-360 
As per section 239(2) (e) and (f) of the Municipal Act regarding litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board, and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.

motions.item_title: 2026 Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Risk Register Update - 2026-363
motions.text: That the report titled “Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Risk Register Update”, dated July 7, 2026, be received.
motions.text_html: 1. That the report titled “Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Risk Register Update”, dated July 7, 2026, be received.
motions.post_html: Councillor Allt raised a Point of Order, questioning if the vote needed to be retaken as he was not present for voting, but moved the item. The Clerk advised that there is no legislative requirement needing a mover to vote, and advised the vote did not need to be retaken.

motions.text: That the updated Budget Policy included as Attachment-1 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved. That the updated User Fees and Charges Policy included as Attachment-2 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved. That the existing Budget Monitoring Policy, Revenue Budgeting Policy, and Year-end Operating Surplus Allocation Policy be repealed. That the updated Debt Management Policy included as Attachment-3 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved. That the updated Reserve and Reserve Fund Policy included as Attachment-4 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved.
motions.text_html:
1. That the updated Budget Policy included as Attachment-1 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved.
  2. That the updated User Fees and Charges Policy included as Attachment-2 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved.
  3. That the existing Budget Monitoring Policy, Revenue Budgeting Policy, and Year-end Operating Surplus Allocation Policy be repealed.
  4. That the updated Debt Management Policy included as Attachment-3 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved.
  5. That the updated Reserve and Reserve Fund Policy included as Attachment-4 to report 2026-357 – Finance Policy Updates, be approved.
